_about: Approved icon and splash artwork per app. A build passes the store-artwork gate only if every icon and splash file it uses is listed here with the same sha256, its colours match, and the app's status is "approved" with approvedBy and approvedOn. Changing status is a reviewed change made only on Paul's explicit approval. Passing the gate for live is not branding approval by itself: the live entry is filled in only after the separate branding decision.

staging.design: Temporary internal staging identifier, not CourtBook branding: large bold white "STG" (Archivo ExtraBold) centred on charcoal #1F2328; no colour, no decoration. Generated by scripts/staging-artwork.py.
